title: Reviews
description: reviews collection and admin module both real and working. SCREEN-MAPPED 2026-08-12 (grounded Explore audit, upgraded from "partial" to "app-mocked" — the write side is now confirmed non-functional, not just unverified): a standalone Reputation Hub module (ReputationAndReviewsScreens.kt, reached from the dashboard, not from any post-booking prompt) has 4 real write screens — Write Review, Completed Project Review, Marketplace Gear Review, Studio Facility Review — plus business-response and report-review screens. None write to the real `reviews` Firestore collection: some persist to a local Room table, the rest are pure no-op UI. `ReviewSchema` (matching admin's ReviewDoc) exists in BackendSchemas.kt but is never referenced. The Business Profile "Reviews & Gallery" tab (already screen-mapped under business_profiles) remains a separate, read-only display of hardcoded data.
